## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Type of change

- [ ] New or changed cases (dataset)
- [ ] Results for a defence
- [ ] Detector adapter, defence or scoring
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation or chore

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `pytest` pass
- [ ] Dataset changes: baselines rerun and `LEADERBOARD.md` regenerated
- [ ] Results: full dataset, and the PR says exactly what was run (model, version, endpoint, settings, date)
- [ ] Attack cases have harmless goals only
